text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr achieved a wonderful 
result. She feels she has gained a great 
deal from this race.

As if competing with that, Tokai Teio 
became an undefeated Satsuki Sho Umamusume 
a few days later.

Yamanin Zephyr seemed inspired by this. 
Her Trainer then proposes their next 
goal... the 1200m sprint race, the Aoi 
Stakes.

Having polished her speed at the Aoi 
Stakes, her next goal is... a GⅠ race! 
Time to build up some momentum here.
